candidates.description: This vector represents characters, diacritics, and sub-word tokens belonging to the Devanagari script alongside isolated punctuation and English sub-words.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel signs, dependent vowel modifiers, and consonant-vowel clusters.
This vector activates on various Hindi vowel sign (matra) characters combined with a comma or punctuation mark.
This vector represents common Hindi suffixes, postpositions, and verb root fragments.
This vector represents Hindi character sequences and consonant-vowel combinations involving the letter 'ह' (ha).
This feature vector represents common prefixes and sub-word roots in the Hindi language.
This vector represents Hindi conditional, temporal, and interrogative conjunctions and adverbial roots.
This feature vector represents common Hindi word suffixes, prefixes, and character combinations.
This feature vector activates on fragments of Hindi text and specific Devanagari script components.
This feature vector represents numerical values corresponding to human ages.
